about: `webagents mcp serve` (plan item 1.8, 2026-09-26): the command's words in both CLIs, the agent file both suites serve, and what an MCP client sees. Over stdio the caller is the local owner (the person at the terminal, as in the chat). Over HTTP the caller is whoever the request verifies as, by `serve`'s rules: a credential must be present, the agent's auth skills and access block identify it, and a caller in no group is `everyone`. Tools are listed sorted by name; their definitions are the todo and web fixtures (todo_tool/definitions.json, web_tool/definition.json), byte for byte, as name, description and inputSchema. Python: webagents/cli/mcp_serve.py, webagents/server/mcp_server.py, tests/cli/test_mcp_serve.py. TypeScript: src/cli/mcp-serve-action.ts, src/server/mcp.ts, tests/unit/cli/mcp-serve.test.ts and tests/unit/server/mcp-server.test.ts.

challenge_note: Every 401 carries the RFC 6750 challenge (2026-09-29): `no_credential` when the request carried nothing, `bad_credential` when it carried a token the agent's auth skills refused. Python: server/core/credential_floor.py `bearer_challenge`; TypeScript: server/credential-floor.ts `bearerChallenge`.
